segments.summary: chat-input box fades/scales in at centre, 8 hexagon-badged agent icons pop in with a 3-frame stagger and then float on a slow sine (each its own phase) to the end, prompt types character by character, the send button clicks (scale 0.90 and back) as the caret goes, then the box rises and everything fades as the icon layer scales outward

centre hex mark pops in with a counter label; an accelerating counter (1 to 100) drives a growing hexagon network while the frame pulls back in steps to 0.32; packets hop along connectors; slow push-in during the hold; pure fade-out
two dark terminal cards slide in from the right with a word-by-word heading and labels; a typed prompt, streamed output, status timer and a packet dot that hops between the cards; shrink-fade exit
same two-card layout with a light right card: typed prompt, packet hop, request block fade-in, running timer, reply bubble with avatar and word pops; shrink-fade exit then hard cut
hexagon network (S02 layout) with its middle row cleared into a feathered band; a 4-word headline pops word by word in the band; slow push-in and packet traffic
end card: the mark settles from the zoom-through, blinks, slides left as the wordmark pops on, tagline pops word by word, URL label pops; static hold to the last frame

notes: All six segments are GRAPHICS; no footage anywhere (checked on every overview sheet sheets/overview_00000-00045.jpg .. overview_01056-01068.jpg).
Detector misses: T1 f101-f122, T2 f328-f354 and T3 f553-f579 were found on the sheets and in motion.csv/luma tracks; c002 only caught the middle of T5.

Flow peaks f339-f353 (flow_mag up to 3.4 % W/f) and f556-f561 are Farneback artefacts on large flat dark cards changing luminance; template tracks show the real card motion is at most 41 px/f (2.1% W) at f338-f339 and the outgoing cards only shrink 3.4%.
The layout exits start 1 frame before beats f329, f554, f779 (every 225 frames = 7.9 beats at 126.05 BPM) and the next layout shows its first picture 9-10 frames after the beat (f338, f563, f788).
S05 reuses the S02 network arrangement (same icon in the same cell); its centre row, which holds the mark in S02, is the text band, and T5 refills it before zooming.
T3's incoming card values repeat T2's frame for frame (offset 225 f); S04's exit repeats S03's exit frame for frame (offset 225 f).
Temporary fits (card opacity, T5 rise) were dropped with curves_tool.py drop; that tool rebuilt curves/index.json, which the merge regenerates anyway.

Cap heights measured on full-res frames with track.py bbox (scratch/cap_*.csv); weights estimated from stem/cap ratio: 0.12 for the headlines and 0.12 for the S01 prompt and placeholder (re-measured in review round 2 at the 50% ink level), all regular.

Review fixes (S01): the 8 icons float on a shared-period sine (sub-pixel template tracks scratch/s1_icon_float.csv); the send button clicks f81-f91 (scratch/s1_sendbtn_press.csv); the exit drift is re-measured from rest f99 with each icon's float extrapolated and removed (scratch/s1_icons_exit_radial.csv), which turns the scattered f95-based drifts into one uniform icon-layer scale.

Review fixes (S02): the badge arrives with its icon and the connector lines draw on 10-11 f after their cell (scratch/s2_cells_badge_link.csv: badge = pixels >= 248 within 0.45 mark widths of the cell centre, icon = pixels < 240 within 0.30, lines = grey 150-236 along the centre line); the pull-back step list is redone from the sub-pixel mark area (scratch/s2_pullback_steps.csv); the push-in curve is re-fit on a cell-based scale track.

Review fixes (S03-S06): spinner rate measured from per-frame changes (scratch/s3_s4_spinner_steps.csv); blink eye extents from the eye holes inside the mark hull (scratch/s6_blink_eye_extent.csv); S05 push-in has its own linear curve (v1.cam-slow-push-in.s05.v1c1).

Review fixes (round 2): (1) packet dots are the front layer wherever they appear: in S03/S04 in front of the cards, their text, the reply bubble and the avatar (the S04 return dot passes in front of the avatar, not under it); in S02/S05 on top of the icons, badges and lines, while the text knockout zone/band hides them like the cells (dots fade through its soft edge); evidence crops listed in the md layer lines, scratch/s3_return_dot_label.csv. (2) S01 prompt typography re-measured on single glyphs: the old bbox (scratch/cap_S1_prompt_S.csv) ran down to the next glyph's descender; flat cap 51 px = 4.7% H on the first digit (scratch/cap_S1_prompt_digit.csv), round first capital 53 px (cap_S1_prompt_cap1.csv), x-height 39 px (xh_S1_prompt.csv), placeholder flat cap 51 px at f10-f11 (cap_S1_placeholder_cap2.csv), stems 6.0 px = 0.12 x cap (scratch/s1_prompt_stems.csv, same method gives 0.12 on the S05 headline), glyph runs scratch/s1_prompt_glyph_runs.csv; new still type/S1-prompt_f00011.png. (3) S04 outbound packet hop measured by a median-background difference-blob track (scratch/s4_packet_out.csv): first visible f647, (799.6, 519.5) -> (1149.5, 399.5), peak 57.0 px/f at f655-f656; it repeats the S03 curve (scratch/s4_packet_vs_s03_curve.csv). (4) curves/v1.logo-blink.v1c1.json relabelled (property scale-y about the bar centre, unit eye-pixel area; note: closed dashes at the vertical middle of the bars, y 360-363, reopen f907-f916) by re-running fit_easing.py on the same samples; the fit itself is unchanged.
